23
Four oxides are listed.
•
calcium oxide
•
copper(II) oxide
•
sulfur dioxide
•
zinc oxide
Which statement about these oxides is correct?
A
All of them contain oxide ions.
B
Only three of them are reduced by carbon to give a metal.
C
Only two of them react with aqueous NaOH to give a salt.
D
Only one of them will give a colour in the flame test.
